message.name: CAN_FRAME
message.description: A forwarded CAN frame as requested by MAV_CMD_CAN_FORWARD.

message.name: CANFD_FRAME
message.description: A forwarded CANFD frame as requested by MAV_CMD_CAN_FORWARD. These are separated from CAN_FRAME as they need different handling (eg. TAO handling)

message.name: CAN_FILTER_MODIFY
message.description: Modify the filter of what CAN messages to forward over the mavlink. This can be used to make CAN forwarding work well on low bandwidth links. The filtering is applied on bits 8 to 24 of the CAN id (2nd and 3rd bytes) which corresponds to the DroneCAN message ID for DroneCAN. Filters with more than 16 IDs can be constructed by sending multiple CAN_FILTER_MODIFY messages.
message.field: what operation to perform on the filter list. See CAN_FILTER_OP enum.
number of IDs in filter list
